name: pit-stop
description: Cleans Claude's memory at a good moment and shows what goes and what stays. Holds an automatic clean-up while Claude is in the middle of a multi-file change.

threshold.title: Offer a clean-up at (% full)
threshold.description: When memory is this full and a turn has ended, Pit Stop offers one clean-up.

hardLimit.title: Always clean up at (% full)
hardLimit.description: At this fullness a clean-up is never held, even in the middle of a change.
